note.note:
I don’t have the transcript or DDx yet. Please paste the raw consult transcript and the DDx JSON so I can generate the Problem List Clinical Note.

Helpful instructions for what to include:
- Full raw transcript of the clinician–patient conversation (you may remove patient identifiers).
- The DDx JSON output from the diagnostic reasoning model.
- Any medication names, allergies, or past medical history not spoken in the transcript (if applicable).
- Note if any portions of the audio were noisy/unintelligible.

Preferred format:
- Paste the transcript between markers (you already used <<< >>> — that’s fine).
- Paste the DDx JSON between markers.

If you want, you can also tell me how many distinct problems you expect (up to three) — otherwise I will identify up to three primary issues from the materials you provide.
